title: Osteochondral Allograft in the Surgical Treatment of Basal Joint Arthritis
brief_summary: This is a study comparing the current standard of care surgical treatment to a newer surgical procedure involving the implantation of osteochondral allograft at the base of the thumb. Patients will be followed at 1, 3, 6 months and 1 year post-operatively.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Indicated for operative management of basal joint arthritis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women/fetuses/neonates, prisoners
* Previously operated on for treatment of basal joint arthritis
